facts.text: Lioness is loosely inspired by a real U.S. military program, "Team Lioness" — but the real one had nothing to do with the CIA. It was a Marine Corps initiative formed in 2003 that sent female support soldiers out alongside infantry in Iraq, since local custom barred male troops from searching Iraqi women.

Real veterans who served in the actual Team Lioness program have publicly criticized the show for fictionalizing their experience into a glamorized CIA-spy premise that bears little resemblance to what they actually did.
Created by Taylor Sheridan — the same creator behind Yellowstone, 1883, and Mayor of Kingstown — Lioness was renewed for Season 3 on October 1, 2025.

Season 3 (8 episodes, released weekly) premiered August 2, 2026 and finished its run with the finale on September 20, 2026 — the season is fully out now, so Bill's remaining episodes are all already available to watch.
Zoe Saldaña stars as CIA station chief Joe McNamara and is also an executive producer; Season 3 brought in two more Oscar winners alongside her, Morgan Freeman (as Edwin Mullins) and Nicole Kidman.
